productionProofs.readerProofMove: Unfold the Option selector and split on existence of a feasible minimizer. The none branch cannot equal some p. In the success branch, some-injectivity identifies p with Classical.choose, whose witness gives both feasibility and global minimality.
productionProofs.boundary: No existence assumption is introduced into the source rule; this is conditional library soundness.

productionProofs.readerProofMove: Split on nonemptiness of the minimizer set. In the nonempty branch both equality to none and negated existence are impossible. In the empty branch the function is definitionally none and the negated existential is exactly the branch hypothesis.
productionProofs.boundary: Exact no-attainment characterization, not just empty-domain failure; no solver or timeout claim.

productionProofs.readerProofMove: Use the finite-index/range sum identity to identify the same t summands. No loss argument, reordering approximation or normalization is changed.

productionProofs.readerProofMove: Sum per-index equality on feasible points to get equality of cumulative objectives on V. Prove equality of entire feasible minimizer sets by extensionality, transporting each minimizing inequality in both directions. Rewrite that set equality inside the literal classical selector. Equal sets induce equal fixed choices without assuming uniqueness.
productionProofs.boundary: Exact equality for this fixed selector, not a theorem that any arbitrary pair of tied source choices must coincide.

productionProofs.readerProofMove: Reduce the t=0 definition branch by reflexivity.

Case split the actual Option output. none contradicts the supplied feasible minimizing witness using failure equivalence. For some q, soundness supplies feasibility/minimality and uniqueness identifies q=p, then map equality through some.
productionProofs.boundary: Uniqueness is a premise only of this named-output library lemma, not a hidden source/definition premise.

productionProofs.readerProofMove: At zero, identify p with initializer and prove the empty objective inequality for every feasible point. At positive t, use function extensionality plus cumulative_prefix, reduce the positive branch, and apply select_some_spec.
productionProofs.boundary: Works at all query indices conditionally on success; no all-round attainment.

productionProofs.readerProofMove: At zero, equality some initializer=none is impossible; the initializer itself witnesses a minimum of the zero objective, contradicting the other side. At positive t, rewrite the finite-index objective as the prefix sum and apply select_none_iff.
productionProofs.boundary: At zero both sides are false, so equivalence does not add a failure case. No absorbing failure semantics.

productionProofs.readerProofMove: At zero both outputs equal the same initializer. Otherwise apply select_congr to the two Fin t prefixes, with each bounded index supplying i.val<t.
productionProofs.boundary: Function-level causality/extensionality on V, not feedback-run or measurable-adapted-process theorem.

definitionCharacterization.literalArgmin: x in V AND forall y in V,C(x)<=C(y), exact whole-carrier set.
definitionCharacterization.selector: some values satisfy that relation, and none iff no witness. Choice is fixed, tied identity unspecified. There is no claim all feasible minimizers equal the chosen point.
definitionCharacterization.predict: Zero branch returns given feasible point and minimizes empty objective. Positive branch inherits exact selector success/failure for strict prefix. Prior none is not state.
definitionCharacterization.existenceUniqueness: No generic attainment or unique tied minimizer theorem. Unique-output lemma has explicit unique-minimizer premise and is used only where private quadratic algebra proves it.
